in_sanskrit.name: पवित्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'pavitra' meaning pure or holy.

in_hindi.name: पवित्रान
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the suffix 'ān' is added to the Sanskrit word 'पवित्र (pavitra)' to form the name 'पवित्रान (pavitrān)'. The long meaning remains the same as in Sanskrit.

in_tamil.name: பவித்ரன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name 'பவித்ரன் (paviθraṉ)' is formed by adding the suffix 'ரன் (raṉ)' to the Sanskrit root 'பவித் (paviθ)'. The long meaning remains the same as in Sanskrit.

in_telugu.name: పవిథ్రన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name 'పవిథ్రన్ (pavithraṉ)' is formed by adding the suffix 'న్ (na)' to the Sanskrit root 'పవిథ్ (pavitha)'. The long meaning remains the same as in Sanskrit.
